'''Rob Burns''' is named on the fan anagram list as the artist unscrambling of [[Bron Burs]] (the card is tagged UGLY on that list, pairing it with ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' in-jokes [[Debnoli]] / [[Gela Yeens]]).

== Anagrams ==

* [[Bron Burs]] — Rob Burns, artist; ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly''

== Other sourced notes ==

No separate Decipher employment record was located this pass. The relation is the published anagram mapping only.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Burns was the key 3D artist on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and built many of its main 3D models.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
